card.text: Explore Lyyli, a Mars-crossing asteroid, with its published shape model at an approximate thermal scale.

introduction.text: Lyyli is a Mars-crossing asteroid. Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Lyyli · DAMIT shape model 2012
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Convex lightcurve reconstruction at approximate thermal scale: 27.12 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.31 km; additional model uncertainty). Grid marks unavailable imagery; pole ambiguity is retained in source notes.

elevation.title: Lyyli · radius relative to the 13.56 km reference sphere
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 13.56 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
